definitions: A software installation process where the previous version is completely removed, and the new version is installed onto a blank or newly formatted system.
The act of installing an operating system or application on a computer that has no prior version of that software or has had all previous versions completely erased.
examples: I decided to do a clean install of the new operating system.
Performing a clean install can often resolve persistent software issues.
A clean install ensures there are no leftover files from previous versions.
